(monthly abatement of $208,095 for the months of January 2027 and January 2028, and a monthly abatement of $212,257 for the month of August 2029), (ii) MSQ Partners NA LLC (monthly abatement of $191,365 from March 2026 through July 2026), and (iii) Trustpilot, Inc.
